text:
Three separate experiments are carried out on an aqueous solution of S.
The results are shown.
1
Magnesium does not react with the solution.
2
A gas is given off when ammonium sulfate is heated with the solution.
3
Methyl orange turns yellow when added to the solution.
What is S?
A
hydrochloric acid
B
sodium hydroxide
C
sodium chloride
D
sulfur dioxide
subject: Chemistry
